flows.title: Create a repository
steps: In the upper-right corner of any page, open the menu and click New repository.
Use the Owner dropdown menu to pick the account that will own the repository.
Type a name for the repository and an optional description, and choose its visibility.
Optionally start it with a README, a .gitignore file or a license.

flows.title: Open an issue
steps: Go to the repository's main page, and under the repository name click Issues.
Click New issue. If the repository uses issue templates, click Get started next to the kind of issue, or click Open a blank issue.
Type a title in the Title field and a description in the comment body field.

flows.title: Open a pull request
steps: Go to the repository's main page and, in the Branch menu, choose the branch that holds your commits.
Above the list of files, in the yellow banner, click Compare & pull request.
Use the base branch dropdown menu to pick the branch to merge into, and the compare branch dropdown menu to pick the branch with your changes.
Type a title and a description.
Click Create Pull Request. For a draft, pick Create Draft Pull Request from the drop-down, then click Draft Pull Request.
